non_blocking_findings.finding: Reprocess currently uses the stored extracted text and does not reopen the original content URI.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Add persisted URI permissions, local source-copy metadata, and original-file re-read semantics before claiming full source import parity.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Source and chunk writes are coordinated by repository calls but not yet wrapped in a dedicated Room transaction boundary.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Introduce a transaction-backed source import coordinator before replacement readiness or broader parser ingestion.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Complex formats remain visible as future-assisted or unsupported instead of being parsed locally.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep PDF, DOCX, PPTX, EPUB, image/OCR, and richer HTML behavior in NATIVE-P5-006 and later parser tasks.

non_blocking_findings.finding: P5-005 has HMA-AL00 instrumentation evidence, but not manual system document picker screenshots.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Capture real picker interaction screenshots during the later Phase 5 validation or Phase 6 device matrix once manual install is explicitly approved.

resolved_review_points.finding: Original implementation attempted to read every selected file as UTF-8 text before parser classification.
resolved_review_points.resolution: Added SourceImportInputFactory so unsupported/binary selections do not read body text and still produce visible source records.
Added readSourceTextWithinLimit with a 500000-character cap; over-limit text returns null and is stored as failed/visible instead of loading indefinitely.

resolved_review_points.finding: Device test clicked duplicate Reprocess text and could target the unsupported card.
resolved_review_points.resolution: Added stable source action test tags and made Phase5SourcesDeviceTest click the Markdown source action by source id.
